name: Osiris — public webcam directory (simplifaisoul)
license: MIT (code and camera lists); images and streams © each publisher
role: Curated list of about 900 public webcams in 74 countries — SkylineWebcams across Asia, Africa, Latin America and Europe, and webcams their operators broadcast on their own sites or YouTube channels — added to the worldwide webcam layer as links to each publisher (a few owner-run streams play in place). Coordinates were resolved by Osiris with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.
